steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each nonconformance needs containment, an owner, a date and a status that matches its containment.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 record is closed while containment is open

findings.title: Closed while containment is still open
findings.fix: Reopen the record until containment is in place

outcome.notChecked: Whether the containment works; the true cause; records never raised.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] nc-0303.md:12  Closed while containment is still open.
       Fix: Reopen the record until containment is in place.
[medium] nc-0305.md:19  No containment recorded.
       Fix: Record the containment action.
[low] nc-0302.md:26  No owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the containment works; the true cause; records never raised.
pros: Checks a record with no containment, no owner, a missing date, or a status that is closed while containment is open.
cons: Not checked: Whether the containment works; the true cause; records never raised.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-nonconformance-log skill on the records for this review.
